title.en: Central Provident Fund (Declaration of Rates of Interest) (No. 4) Notification 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Central Provident Fund (Declaration of Rates of Interest) (No. 4) Notification 2024 and comes into operation on 1 January 2025.

2. It is declared that interest is payable —
(a)on the amounts standing to the credit of a member of the Fund in the member’s ordinary account and nominee ordinary account (if any), at the rate of 2.5% per annum; and
(b)on the amounts standing to the credit of a member of the Fund in the member’s medisave account, nominee medisave account, special account, nominee special account, retirement account and nominee retirement account (if any), at the rate of 4% per annum.
3. Revoke the Central Provident Fund (Declaration of Rates of Interest) (No. 3) Notification 2024 (G.N. No. S 740/2024).
